subject: VertexHealth CSA evidence & control mapping request

From: Asha Menon <security@vertexhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: CSA request: control mapping + evidence for procurement review

Hi Rishi,

We're starting VertexHealth's procurement review and need a CAIQ-style mapping from Redwood for the controls in scope. Procurement pulled the attached requirements but the security team needs three concrete things to proceed:

- A control mapping that ties each CAIQ question to a Redwood control/owner and a pointer to evidence (Drive link or attachment).
- Sample artifacts for key controls (KMS rotation proof, IAM role inventory, a short extract of telemetry/log lines showing tenant isolation and prefix caching behavior).
- A proposed timeline for delivering a full evidence bundle (we're hoping for a complete package within 10 business days).

A few clarifications: we're focusing on controls related to identity & access, key management, runtime isolation, and logging/retention. If you have a recommended subset of models or model variants that should be called out for the CAIQ (hosted vs. dedicated), please note that in the mapping.

Can you confirm owners and an ETA? Procurement would also like to see any redlines you expect (e.g., residency or retention exceptions).

Thanks,
Asha Menon
Security Lead, VertexHealth
security@vertexhealth.com

Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Asha Menon <security@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CSA request: control mapping + evidence for procurement review

Asha — thanks for the clear ask. We can take this on. High level plan:

- I (Rishi) will own the mapping and will deliver a CAIQ crosswalk that links each question to a Redwood control, a short control description, owner, and a pointer to evidence.
- Kimberly will collect KMS and key-management artifacts (policy, rotation schedule, HSM/KMS attestations).
- Marissa will surface telemetry and runtime isolation samples (log extracts and a brief narrative).

Attachment: csa_mapping_draft.xlsx (first-pass mapping, spreadsheet with three tabs: questions, control-owners, evidence-index)

Can you confirm the list of controls you consider high-priority? If 10 business days is required we can aim for a draft in 4 business days and a completed package in 9 — that gives us a day for legal/ops review. If that timeline works for you, we'll start the artifact pull right away.

- Rishi
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Subject: Internal: VertexHealth artifacts — owners & action items

Rishi / Marissa — quick internal note as I start pulling artifacts. Summary of what I'll attach into the evidence bundle and where to find them in Drive: 

Action items and artifacts: 
- KMS rotation policy (kms_rotation_policy_v2.pdf) — shows rotation cadence, rotation playbooks and KMS key ARN list. Owner: kimberly_park.
- Key rotation proof (rotation job run logs) — will provide a sanitized sample (kv_access_log_sample.txt) with timestamps and key IDs redacted. Owner: infra-ops but I will collate.
- IAM role inventory + last modification dates — I'll export a CSV and add to the Drive folder; will include a short narrative on role scoping for hosting tiers. Owner: identity-team.
- Telemetry snippet for tenant isolation/cache behavior — Marissa, can you pull a 200-line sample and short explanation of the prefix caching eviction policy? We want to show the cache TTLs and how burst isolation works.

Timeline: aiming to drop an initial artifact set into the Drive link (https://drive.redwood.com/v/vertex/csa-request-20260720) by end of day Thursday (2026-07-23). Finalize after your review and redaction by Friday.

I'll attach KMS policy now for immediate review.

Attachment: kms_rotation_policy_v2.pdf

—Kimberly
Head of Cloud Security Operations

Rishi / Kimberly — thanks, this looks good. We received the csa_mapping_draft.xlsx and the KMS policy PDF in the Drive link. Procurement confirmed the timeline is acceptable provided we see the key rotation proof and a small telemetry sample.

One small ask: can the log sample have seven continuous hours (UTC) and include a short README that explains the fields and redaction? Also please include the assertion in the mapping where you call out hosted vs dedicated model scope (we need to know if any evidence differs by deployment type).

If it's helpful I can send over a short checklist from our side that enumerates mandatory artifacts and minimum retention windows — I can aim to have that by tomorrow morning.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Asha
